results.title: Norway FIFA World Cup 2026 Predicted Lineup: Will Haaland Play?
highlights:
## Norway Predicted Lineup for FIFA World Cup 2026 Under Ståle Solbakken
[...]
Norway are expected to use a 4-3-3 formation at the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The system gives them extra control in midfield while allowing their attacking stars to stay high up the pitch.
[...]
The predicted lineup features Ørjan Nyland in goal. The back four could consist of Julian Ryerson at right-back. Kristoffer Ajer and Torbjørn Heggem in central defence. David Møller Wolfe at left-back.
[...]
In midfield, captain Martin Ødegaard is expected to start alongside Sander Berge and Kristian Thorstvedt.
[...]
The front three could feature Alexander Sørloth on the right, Erling Haaland through the middle, and Antonio Nusa on the left.
[...]
Predicted Norway XI: Nyland; Ryerson, Ajer, Heggem, Møller Wolfe; Ødegaard, Berge, Thorstvedt; Sørloth, Haaland, Nusa.
[...]
The biggest threat comes from the front three. Haaland provides the goals, Nusa brings pace and dribbling. Sørloth adds physicality and aerial strength. Behind them, Ødegaard remains the team’s main creative force.

[...]
Egypt have the firepower and the format on their side. Expect them to compete for second place in Group G behind Belgium, and the expanded 48-team structure gives them a strong chance to reach the round of 32 for the first time in their history. A historic first World Cup win feels overdue and achievable. Beyond that, a Salah-inspired run to the round of 16 is the dream ceiling; a tight group-stage exit remains the downside risk if the attack misfires.
